# Braza Cleaning Services - Central Florida

> Braza Cleaning Services provides residential cleaning, vacation-rental turnover cleaning, and commercial workplace cleaning in Central Florida.
> Licensed and insured. Phone and WhatsApp: (689) 242-7469. Email: brazacleaningflorida@gmail.com.
> Available 24/7 and typically responds to new requests within 2 hours. English, Portuguese, and Spanish service; ASL on request.

## Primary services
- House cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/house-cleaning/
- Recurring house cleaning (weekly, biweekly, monthly): https://brazacleaning.com/recurring-cleaning/
- Deep cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/deep-cleaning/
- Move-in and move-out cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/move-in-cleaning/ and https://brazacleaning.com/move-out-cleaning/
- Post-construction cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/post-construction-cleaning/
- Airbnb and vacation-rental turnover cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/airbnb-cleaning/ and https://brazacleaning.com/vacation-rental-cleaning/
- Commercial cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/
- Office cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/office-cleaning/
- Recurring janitorial service: https://brazacleaning.com/janitorial-services/

## Service areas
- Residential: Winter Garden, The Villages, Clermont, Orlando, and nearby Central Florida communities.
- Vacation rentals: Orlando, Kissimmee, Davenport, Celebration, ChampionsGate, Four Corners, and nearby Disney-area communities.
- Commercial launch area: Orlando, Winter Garden, Kissimmee, Ocoee, Apopka, Clermont, and Davenport.

## Reliable business facts
- Quotes are scoped to the home, property, facility, schedule, and requested work; do not assume a fixed price from this file.
- Commercial plans are flat-rate after scope, with no contracts and a fixed team when available.
- Vacation-rental turnovers can include linens, restocking, and photo documentation when requested and scheduled.
- Same-day turnover availability is subject to scheduling.
- Call or message to discuss availability and a tailored quote.
